title: Hm! hm! hm!
subtitle: Papageno, Tamino and the three Ladies: quintet from Die Zauberflöte, Act 1

passages.label: Hm! hm! hm!: Papageno padlocked, Tamino pities him
Die Königin begnadigt dich · Dies Schloss soll deine Warnung sein
Bekämen doch die Lügner alle (all five)
O Prinz, nimm dies Geschenk · Hiemit kannst du allmächtig handeln
O! so eine Flöte ist mehr als Gold und Kronen werth (all five)
Nun, ihr schönen Frauenzimmer · Sarastro rupfen, braten
Hier nimm dies Kleinod · Silberglöckchen, Zauberflöten
Lebet wohl · Wie man die Burg wohl finden kann? (to the fermata)

licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages by two independent readers, with a judge settling every difference and a sweep for the marks, then a fresh check until clean (one fix: bar 163 Papageno D4); every bar of every part adds up. The Italian translation, the notes printed only for it, and the stage directions are left out. The print puts the Ladies two to a staff and Tamino and Papageno on one staff in places; each singer has their own line here. Papageno’s “Hm!” is hummed with the mouth closed. The quintet goes on after the fermata and double bar with “Drei Knäbchen” (a separate piece in the app). Playback tempo from complete recordings: the median length of this section, about 4:43, from Haitink 1981, whose track ends before “Drei Knaben” (5:05), and Klemperer 1964, Böhm 1964, Christie 1995 and Abbado 2005, whose No. 5 tracks (6:44, 6:27, 5:50, 5:46) were given this section’s share of the quintet in Haitink’s recording (73.1%).
